scenario: A recruiter processes a software engineering candidate by (1) parsing and scoring the resume, (2) producing a structured hiring scorecard across standard criteria, and (3) generating a competitive compensation offer package based on the scorecard outcome and role level.
info_flow: ai-resume-screener parses the candidate resume and produces a structured profile with extracted fields (skills, experience, education, flags) and an initial match score. afrexai-hiring-scorecard receives the profile and applies weighted criteria to produce a hire/no-hire recommendation with numeric scores per dimension. afrexai-compensation-planner receives the scorecard recommendation and role level to generate a compensation offer package.
